target.statement: D2Match achieves 100.0% accuracy on the Mutag dataset (subgraph matching classification).

compute.basis: Training a small GNN (5 layers, hidden dim 10) on ~1000 graph pairs of small graphs (avg 18 nodes) for up to 500 epochs; CPU is sufficient, GPU gives modest speedup.

blockers: Code is promised but not yet released (as of paper submission).
Data generation scripts may not be included; need to implement synthetic query generation from raw Mutag graphs.
Exact hyperparameters (learning rate, batch size, sampling K) may need tuning to reproduce 100% accuracy.
title: D2Match: Leveraging Deep Learning and Degeneracy for Subgraph Matching
